role: A post-open representation-capacity diagnostic on the already consumed BLASTNet Case 7 tails. It is not a deployment method, predictor, prospective external confirmation, or resource measurement.
scientific_question: At the same total dimension 64 as the failed v236 global rank-64 tail subspace, does a fixed 2x2x2 spatial direct sum with rank 8 learned independently inside each octant transfer the K16-minus-fixed-Low64-K11 tail to every held-out camera rig?

not_computed_before_freeze: any v238 per-cell residual, tail summary, or decision
post_open_boundary.claim_limit: A pass is only post-open Case 7 geometry-local representation headroom and cannot authorize a predictor without a separate result-before-training contract.

sealed_inputs.v235_root_role: private independently validated Case 7 reconstruction tree outside Git
sealed_inputs.v236_root_role: private independently validated global-tail attribution tree outside Git

unique_primary.name: loro_octant_direct_sum_rank8x8
unique_primary.partition: Split z at 16, y at 8, and x at 8. Enumerate the eight disjoint half-open blocks lexicographically by z half, then y half, then x half. Every field voxel belongs to exactly one block.
unique_primary.folds: For held-out rig h, each block training matrix contains the 42 tails from each of the other twelve rigs, for 504 rows. All 42 tails from h are held out.
unique_primary.block_basis: For each block independently, use the uncentered rank-8 principal subspace of the 504x1024 block-tail matrix.
unique_primary.formal_solver: Eigendecompose each 504x504 sample Gram matrix in descending order and explicitly reconstruct eight orthonormal block basis rows.
unique_primary.independent_solver: Direct economy SVD of each 504x1024 block training matrix in a separate program that does not import the formal implementation.
unique_primary.oracle_projection: Project each held-out truth tail independently inside all eight block bases and concatenate the blocks. Coefficients are truth-aware and nondeployable; this tests span capacity only.
forbidden_variants: rank search or unequal block ranks
centering, weighting, smoothing, or boundary blending
changed v235 depth, basis, inverse, regularizer, or threshold
CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, or GPU rescue

controls.sealed_global_loro_rank64: Use the independently validated v236 global rank-64 residuals and summaries without recomputation or reinterpretation.
controls.sealed_fixed_low64_span: Use the independently validated v236 fixed Low64 control residuals and summaries without recomputation or reinterpretation.
controls.fairness: The primary and global control both have total dimension 64 and use the same held-out rigs, tails, oracle projection role, and gates.

decision_order: Any source, input, parent-decision, shape, finite, norm, partition, rank, orthogonality, fold, sealed-control, formal-independent numeric, output-seal, or discrete-decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE7_OCTANT_TAIL_CAPACITY_V238.

If the unique octant rank8x8 primary fails any all-frame or late-frame gate in any held-out rig, conclude FAIL_CASE7_OCTANT_TAIL_SUBSPACE_CAPACITY_V238 and close only this fixed nonoverlapping 2x2x2 rank8-per-block representation.
If the primary passes but the sealed global rank-64 control also passes, conclude PASS_CASE7_OCTANT_CAPACITY_NOT_LOCALITY_ISOLATED_V238.

Only if the primary passes every held-out-rig gate while both sealed v236 controls fail may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE7_OCTANT_TAIL_CAPACITY_HEADROOM_V238. This does not authorize deployment coefficients or an algorithm claim.
